text: The purpose of the closest established-comparator check is to determine whether SCALE improves on betting rather than only on RATIO. On 50 matched Office-Home models at α = 0.20 with 1,000 identity-only traffic draws, BETTING-H exceeds RATIO by 6.570 percentage points, while SCALE-H exceeds RATIO by 6.631 points. Established betting uses the same frozen selectors and evidence [13]. The residual SCALE-H-minus-BETTING-H difference is 0.061 points with a pointwise descriptive interval of [−0.078, 0.201]. Both procedures certify 50/50 models and select the same family member in 49/50. Existing betting therefore explains nearly all of the apparent improvement over RATIO.
